WoW Forever dungeons and raids

All 49 WoW Forever dungeons, raids, battlegrounds and arenas in client build 1.60.1.70862, by level: 31 dungeons, 12 raids, 5 battlegrounds and an arena, with every boss in the game's own order, group sizes, entry levels and lockouts. The Group Finder files 28 of those dungeons, from level 13 to 60. Blizzard has announced 0 more dungeons and 2 more raids that this build does not carry at all; they are listed here too, marked announced, with what Blizzard said about each: a level range for the dungeons, a group size and an opening date for the raids. Type your level in the finder and the doors you cannot enter yet lock; the tables under it list every dungeon by level.

  • 3raids Blizzard has named for launch
  • 11raids in the client, not confirmed

WoW Forever dungeons by level

Every dungeon by level: the ones in the client in the order the Group Finder files them. The Group Finder level is the one the client's finder rows carry; the entry level is what the door itself checks, and it is often lower. Quests are the ones the beta server filed under that dungeon, and each dungeon's page prints them in full; all 159 it described, across 21 instances, are gathered quest by quest on the quests page. The 0 dungeons Blizzard has only announced have no Group Finder row and no map in this build, so they sort by the bottom of the level range Blizzard gave them, carry that range as a tag, and read as a dash in every column the client would have filled.

What the client says, and what it does not

Names, the bosses and their order, the rows an instance can be entered on with their player caps and lockout codes, the "you must be at least level N" check on the door, the Group Finder's level, the named areas inside, the battleground loading texts, the PvP queue list (players a side, level band, rated play, the modes a map is queued as) and the loading-screen art all come from the client files. Blizzard's test maps and the Season of Discovery solo phases are left out, each with its reason recorded.

Boss abilities, loot and trash live on the server, and neither build carries the Adventure Guide tables that would describe encounters, so none of that is here. Each boss links to Wowhead's Forever database, which fills from players' uploads and does not list the new bosses yet. Quests are server-side too, and the beta server answered for those: the Quests column above counts what a running client was told, never what another site says.

★ marks an instance or boss new in Forever, ◆ an instance whose group size, entry level, bosses or lockout rows differ from Classic Era build 1.15.9.69722. Turn on Show original Classic to read the Classic values under anything that changed. One change runs through most old dungeons: Forever caps them at 5 players where Classic Era let 10 in.

Raids are the exception. The client carries every raid map from Classic and Season of Discovery with its old rows, and cannot tell a launch raid from a leftover, so the raid list adds what Blizzard has actually said. Three raids are confirmed for launch, opening on 9 December 2026: Barrow Deeps for 10 players and Hyjal Summit for 20, neither in the client yet, and Onyxia's Lair for 40. Every other raid is marked not confirmed with its group size shown as the client's leftover; Blizzard's roadmap puts the vanilla raids after launch and pencils a revamped iconic raid in for summer 2027.

This site asks for nothing. The kids could use something.
